summary: Eight days to FreightWorks Expo. Pinecrest signed, so three design partners are signed; Coastal's login outage is fixed. Valley is booking through Smart Slots. Print files are due tomorrow and the booth ships Thursday. Booth-readiness work is in progress. Harbor renews Oct 30.

items.text: Pinecrest signed as third Smart Slots design partner (TW-126 done). Signing meets the three-partner count; the partners still have to be live by launch.
Pinecrest kickoff and data access (TW-151) is due Oct 29, with kickoff Thursday. Pinecrest wants to be live before Expo.
Coastal logins work again since yesterday afternoon. Cause was an identity provider certificate rotation; Arjun added a check. TW-144 and TW-145 (Maya's call with Grace) are done.
TW-121 (Coastal and Valley live on Smart Slots) is still in progress, due Oct 30. Valley booked 140 slots through Smart Slots yesterday.
Booth print files (TW-150) are due tomorrow, Oct 28, and are in progress. The booth ships Thursday.
Booth staffing will be two people at a time, in shifts. Maya wants to lock the shift plan on Thursday.
Maya wants four investor meetings booked at the Expo booth (TW-152, due Oct 30, todo).
Launch announcement post for Nov 4 (TW-153) is created, todo, due Nov 3.
Demo flow (TW-119, due Oct 30) was 2:10 in the last dry run against Sam's under-two-minute target. Maya's booth script (TW-120) is in progress, due Oct 30.
Scoring API TW-115 (due Oct 28) passed a 5x load test. Nina's 10x test TW-143 is due Oct 30. Coastal ranking changes (TW-138, due Oct 28) are in staging.

Booth-readiness work: TW-147 demo environment (Arjun, Oct 29), TW-148 score caching (Nina, Oct 30) and TW-149 tablet mode (Leila, Oct 29) are in progress. TW-146 rate limits (Arjun, Oct 30) is still todo.
Empty and error states (TW-135) are merged and done.
Harbor (38% of revenue) renews Oct 30. All QBR follow-ups are done: TW-139, TW-140 and TW-142.
Ridgeline (22% of revenue, health yellow, renews Nov 20) had repeated duplicates; the root-cause fix has shipped. Renewal prep TW-113 is now in progress, due Nov 13.
Smart Slots help center articles (TW-124, three articles) are in progress, due Nov 3.
Arjun is on call this week; Leila is on call the week of Nov 2.
